text: The one‑to‑many relationship is expressed by adding a ForeignKey field on the “many” side, because that model stores the foreign‑key column in the database [1]. In the blog example the author field is defined inside the Post model, linking each post to a single Author (and allowing an author to have many posts) [1]. Thus the correct placement is the Post model with author = models.ForeignKey(Author, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='posts'). This follows the same pattern used for the author field that ties posts to the user model [1].
